podcasts.title: Duck Gun Podcast

podcasts.title: The Southern Outdoorsmen Hunting Podcast
podcasts.description: The Southern Outdoorsmen is a weekly deer hunting podcast for serious DIY whitetail hunters, hosted by Andrew Maxwell and Jacob Myers. No fluff, no big-name filler. Just proven whitetail tactics you can put to work this fall.Want to be a woodsman? Start here.

podcasts.title: The Apron Bump Podcast
podcasts.description: Pro Wrestling commentary and tomfoolery for fans who want to be fans. A blend of the old and new, the mainstream and non-mainstream. Let’s not take oiled up men in their underpants too seriously. Chronologically covering various eras of wrestling. Companies big and small, across four different decades. Monday Night Wars. Attitude Era. Ruthless Aggression. Golden Eras of TNA, ROH, and PROGRESS. And much much more, tune in! The goal of this podcast is to reflect on the things we love about wrestling, as well as poke fun at the hilarity that often ensues. Let’s not take things too seriously. Let’s have fun.

podcasts.title: Windy City Slam
podcasts.description: Wrestling, Chicago-Style

podcasts.title: The Jose Morales Podcast
podcasts.description: The Jose Morales Podcast delivers a knockout punch of inspiration and insight, exploring the profound impact of boxing on lives from all walks of life. Host Jose Morales brings together a dynamic roster of guests, representing every facet of the boxing world. From current and former athletes who've felt the sting of the canvas and the thrill of victory, to the strategic minds of boxing promoters and coaches, each episode offers a unique perspective. We also feature passionate boxing enthusiasts and gym owners, all sharing their personal stories of how boxing has shaped their lives. Join us as we delve into the ring and beyond, uncovering the lessons learned, the challenges overcome, and the transformative power of boxing.

podcasts.title: Getting Over: Wrestling Podcast
podcasts.description: Award-winning analysis of pro wrestling with breakdowns of WWE, NXT, AEW and beyond. Plus, instant analysis of pay-per-views, news coverage and major interviews. Host Adam Silverstein and co-host Chris Vannini pull back the curtain addressing the hottest topics and most controversial developments while putting the highs and lows of sports entertainment in context every week.

podcasts.title: Talk'n Shop
podcasts.description: Karl Anderson and Luke Gallows have repented and resurrected Talk N’ Shop so buckle up and enjoy the ride as the original “Good Brothers” record live from the road every single week with real time takes on wild world of professional wrestling!

podcasts.title: The W.H.I.P. Show
podcasts.description: Welcome to The Wrestling Heroes and Insiders Podcast aka The WHIP Show! Each week DeSean "Whipdog" Whipple and "Devastating" Daryl Pace interview some of the top personalities in the Pro Wrestling world!

podcasts.title: The Turnbuckle Tavern
podcasts.description: Weekly breakdown of this weeks AEW Dynamite episode, plus hot takes on everything going on in the pro-wrestling industry!

podcasts.title: D3 Nation
podcasts.description: D3 Nation's mission is to promote and support DIII wrestling. As former DIII student-athletes and current coaches, we have competed against incredible wrestlers, coaches, and programs. My brother and I want to bring these stories into the limelight. We will also strive to bring current news and results throughout the year. We are dedicated to growing DIII wrestling and highlighting the amazing people that are in the DIII community. Currently 118 programs strong and continuing to grow!

podcasts.title: ROLL OR DIE
podcasts.description: BJJ Podcast hosted by Kim Potgieter and Brent Dry bringing on guests from across the globe who have interesting life stories or journeys. Very casual and light, and easy to digest at under 45 mins per episode.

podcasts.title: Scottish Wrestling Network
podcasts.description: Welcome to the Scottish Wrestling Network – Your Home for Scottish Pro Wrestling! Step into the ring with the Scottish Wrestling Network (SWN) – the #1 destination for everything related to Scottish professional wrestling. Whether you're a die-hard fan, a new viewer, or part of the wrestling scene yourself, our channel brings you the best of Scotland's indie wrestling promotions, exclusive interviews, match previews, podcasts, wrestler spotlights, and more. Join the community. Support local wrestling. Subscribe now and become part of the SWN family!

podcasts.title: Instinct Culture by Denise Salcedo
podcasts.description: Instinct Culture by Denise Salcedo started off as YouTube channel that provides pro wrestling content. Now Denise has expanded by making all of her podcasts available to listen to in podcast form! She is live multiple times a week covering WWE RAW on Mondays, WWE NXT on Tuesdays, AEW Dynamite on Wednesdays, WWE Smackdown on Fridays and PPVs/PLEs with her unique round of co-hosts! They all bring entertaining, energetic and informative wrestling coverage. Denise will also upload her top interviews here with some of the biggest stars in pro wrestling! So whether you're driving in your car or taking a walk--- you can keep up with the very best in wrestling with Denise!
